details.label: Status
details.text: `[FACT]`:
83 jobs lost in 3 runs: 35 failed in the 13:10 rocm10 PR Test, 31 failed and 3 were cancelled in the 19:05 rocm720 PR Test, and 14 failed in the 16:08 rocm10 nightly.

The last pass was the Nov 17 01:10 PR Test on [`6c9a1938`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/6c9a1938d033d532e66cb41a95e9047819296ee4) (image `…-20261116`, `ml_dtypes 0.6.0`). details.label: Top hypothesis
details.text: `[HIGH]` the cause is a PyPI release, not an sglang change. `ml-dtypes 0.7.0` (uploaded Nov 16 16:20) is baked into the `20261117` images. `amd_ci_install_dependency.sh` then downgrades numpy to 1.26.4 for lmms-eval v0.4.1, and `tvm_ffi` → `ml_dtypes._ml_dtypes_ext` fails with `C-API version 0x12 … 0x11`. The same chain hit CUDA and was fixed there by [#50940](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/50940) ([`bb477b23`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/bb477b23)). **Disconfirming**: pip says 0.6.0 also needs numpy≥2, yet 0.6.0 worked, so only 0.7.0 breaks. The new aiter (`581579ab`) was not ruled out by an A/B run.

details.label: In-flight fix
details.text: ✅ merged [#51044](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/51044) ([`b43c4c00`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/b43c4c00a64811c05f937724c47ec18f92efd4bb), 19:11) adds `"ml-dtypes<0.6"`. [#51039](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/pull/51039) (open) duplicates it.
`[FACT]` The run by hand at 19:23 on [`b43c4c00`](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/commit/b43c4c00a64811c05f937724c47ec18f92efd4bb) shows no import error in its 5 failed jobs.
